title: Royal Caribbean — Singapore & Southeast Asia
overview_paragraphs: Southeast Asia by large cruise liner means waking up in Penang, Phuket, or Langkawi without the logistics of separate flights and hotels between each — and a ship with more onboard activity than most resorts. This route departs from Singapore and threads through some of the region's best port stops.
Suited to families and groups who want variety in destinations with the convenience and onboard entertainment of a major cruise line.

itinerary.title: Embarkation — Singapore
itinerary.desc: Board in Singapore in the afternoon, with an evening sail-away from Marina Bay Cruise Centre.

itinerary.title: Day at Sea
itinerary.desc: A full day onboard to explore the ship's pools, rock climbing wall, and entertainment shows.

itinerary.title: Penang, Malaysia
itinerary.desc: Dock in Penang for George Town's UNESCO-listed street art and colonial architecture, with free time for the hawker food scene.

itinerary.title: Phuket, Thailand
itinerary.desc: A day in Phuket — optional excursions to Phang Nga Bay or simply time on Patong Beach.

itinerary.title: Day at Sea
itinerary.desc: A relaxed sea day before returning to Singapore.

itinerary.title: Disembarkation
itinerary.desc: Return to Singapore and disembark for your onward journey.
